notes:
Topline: mid-market CCaaS provider (Brookline) looking to add ML-first agent-assist and automated ticket summarization for enterprise customers. Primary selling points for them: reliable citations (agent and end-user facing), freshness of knowledge, and predictable behavior under volume spikes.

Use-case details:
- Agent assist: inline co-pilot suggestions, suggested macros, citation links back to KB articles; must show provenance for agent to trust.
- Ticket summarization: generate TL;DR + structured fields (issue type, urgency, suggested routing) with concise excerpts and links.
- Tool-calling: require model-initiated tool calls to internal ticketing API (create/update/ticket-tag) and escalation workflows; transaction safety & idempotency are required.
- RAG requirements: multi-source retrieval across product KB, release notes, community forum, and past tickets. Need hybrid search (BM25 + vectors) to handle short queries + long docs. Incremental indexing: daily sync but also on-demand pushes for hot fixes.

Performance & reliability:
- Latency SLO: agent-facing responses < 300ms for autocomplete-like suggestions, < 1s for full suggestion payloads.
- Throughput: avg 500 reqs/min during business hours, burst to 10k reqs/min during promos/Black-Friday style spikes.
- Cost sensitivity: wants predictable per-token economics; evaluating Dedicated pools vs hosted with burst capacity.
- Fallbacks: must degrade gracefully to small, deterministic model or cached answers; audit trail for every fallback decision.

Security/compliance:
- Data residency: EU customers require regional routing and retention controls.
- Keys: customer-managed KMS preferred for production.
- Audit: per-request provenance and user attribution, long-term logs (90-365 days).

Quotes / call snippets:
- "If it can't show me a snippet + link, agents won't use it." - Head of Support
- "We need the model to call our ticket API. Can it do that safely and retry idempotently?" - CTO

POC scope proposed:
1) 2-week RAG POC: index 3 sources (KB, forum, recent 30k tickets) into a hybrid retrieval pipeline + Redwood dedicated 1-node serving for agent-assist. Measure: precision@3, average latency, token cost per session.
2) Tool-calling sandbox: demo model -> API call flow with simulated failures and idempotent retries; audit logs visible in Console.
3) Spike test: synthetic load to 10k rps for 15 minutes to validate autoscale/burst.

Open questions for SE / Product:
- Which vector DB recommend for daily incremental updates and region isolation? (customer prefers non-managed or bring-your-own option)
- Support for citation formatting to satisfy legal/regulatory screenshots?
- Granular cost controls (per-route budgets) and traceability to agent IDs.
